subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: kb/Work PB1400 LANDED (w1095j). A group explicitly or implicitly described GROUP-USAGE NATIONAL is category and class national everywhere it is asked: LENGTH/MOVE (pb522; pb1400_group_usage_operand_class: MOVE N"PQR" TO GN as an elementary PIC N(3), GN = N"PQR", subordinate GNS moved as a national sender) and now the arithmetic-operand refusal, which said 'class alphanumeric' (the refuter's residual): COMPUTE N = GN + 1 / GNS + 1 -> 'group item GN of class national (ISO 8.5.2.1)', through IntrinsicArgumentRules.ClassNameOf over ClassOfPlace. The separate group-MOVE lead (a national group moved into an alphanumeric group) belongs to GR-8.5.2.3-3, not this row.
